bagPolicy.summary: Bags and backpacks are allowed up to DIN A4 (21.0 x 29.7 cm). Larger bags are not allowed in.
allowed: Bags and backpacks up to DIN A4 (21.0 x 29.7 cm)
bagPolicy.note: Larger bags can be stored on the forecourt for 5,00 euros per item. Concert promoters may set stricter rules.

parking.summary: Car parks P04, P05 and P07 are listed for cars, with limited spaces near the venue; the venue recommends public transport.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general rideshare pickup location for concerts; consult the event instructions.
rideshare.note: Taxis usually drop passengers at the end of Passenheimer Straße, about 400 metres from the main entrance. Road closures prevent drop-off directly at the entrances. After the show, taxis may wait on Passenheimer Straße, but there is no fixed taxi rank. Have a taxi booking app or phone number ready.

concessions.summary: Food trucks and stands sell hot dogs, currywurst, pizza and other snacks. Outside food and snacks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is in P08; contact the venue at least one week before an event for accessible arrangements.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert re-entry rule for concerts; consult the event instructions.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: If a concert isn't sold out, you can buy tickets at the box office opposite the Glockenturm entrance. It opens at door time, shown on each event page, and sells tickets only for that day's event.

gates.summary: Doors normally open two hours before the event; check the event details because promoters may change timings.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
